name: Fen Luan: Wu Hongzhuang
source:
In the first year of the Shenlong Era, Zhang Jianzhi, Yuan Shuji, and their allies launched the historic "Shenlong Coup," forcing Empress Wu Zetian to abdicate and restoring Crown Prince Li Xian to the throne.

Yet, the new Emperor’s ascension did not usher in an era of prosperity. Instead, undercurrents surged as various factions bided their time.

Conspiracies, assassinations, coups, and armed mutinies.

Filthy blood stains the golden halls, while pure white flowers bloom amidst the smoldering ruins.

The protagonist—you—were once a mere Jinwu Guard patrolling the streets, only to be swept into a catastrophic web of intrigue.

Between loyalty and betrayal, love and desire, cold calculation and innate kindness.

Follow the choices of your heart to forge a "historical destiny" that belongs to you alone.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2496310/]Steam[/url]]
